name: ES Overnight Money Profile
description: Dollar-weighted volume profile (money profile) for the ES overnight session (18:00-09:30 ET). Computes POC, Value Area High, and Value Area Low using price × volume weighting over the full overnight window. Levels persist into RTH via forward-fill for reference during the day session.
source:
# ES Overnight Money Profile
# Dollar-weighted volume profile for the overnight session (18:00-09:30 ET)
# Money profile = price_profile where volume input is close × volume (dollar flow)

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
volume = cont.v

# --- Overnight Session Detection ---
# Overnight = 18:00 to 09:30 ET (prior evening to RTH open)
ts = index()
ovn_session = session_window(
    session=Session(start='18:00', end='09:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(cont.o, cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, cont.v)

is_overnight = ovn_session.active

# --- Money Profile (dollar-weighted) ---
# Money flow = close × volume gives dollar-weighted volume at each price level
dollar_volume = close * volume

# Compute profile over 690-bar window (full overnight session)
# Using dollar_volume as the volume input creates a money-weighted profile
money_profile = price_profile(
    window_size=500,
    tick_size=0.25,
    value_area_pct=0.7,
    mode=ProfileType.volume
)(high, low, close, dollar_volume)

# Extract raw levels (update every bar)
raw_poc = money_profile.poc
raw_vah = money_profile.vah
raw_val = money_profile.val

# Capture overnight levels: take the value when overnight session closes
# Then forward-fill through RTH so levels persist as reference
ovn_closed = ovn_session.closed
ovn_poc = ffill_day(where(ovn_closed, raw_poc))
ovn_vah = ffill_day(where(ovn_closed, raw_vah))
ovn_val = ffill_day(where(ovn_closed, raw_val))

# Also keep live overnight levels during the session itself
live_poc = where(is_overnight, raw_poc)
live_vah = where(is_overnight, raw_vah)
live_val = where(is_overnight, raw_val)

# Combined: live during overnight, frozen during RTH
poc = coalesce(live_poc, ovn_poc)
vah = coalesce(live_vah, ovn_vah)
val = coalesce(live_val, ovn_val)

# Value area width
va_width = vah - val

# --- Overnight Session Stats ---
ovn_high = ovn_session.high
ovn_low = ovn_session.low
ovn_range = where(ovn_closed, ovn_high - ovn_low)
ovn_vol = where(ovn_closed, ovn_session.volume)

# --- Output: Money Profile Levels Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title='Where Is Overnight Dollar Flow Concentrated?',
    category='Overnight Money Profile',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='POC', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VAH', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VAL', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(poc, vah, val))

# --- Output: Overnight Range and VA Width ---
xy_lines(
    title='How Wide Is the Overnight Value Area?',
    category='Overnight Money Profile',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VA Width', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Session Range', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    y_axis_label='Points',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(va_width, ffill_day(ovn_range)))

# --- Output: Summary Table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Overnight Money Profile Levels',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Money Profile', 'Session Stats'],
        col_headers=['POC', 'VAH', 'VAL'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, dp=2, info='Overnight range in points'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, dp=0, info='Overnight session volume'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, dp=2, info='Value area width in points')
        ]
    ),
    category='Overnight Money Profile',
    order=0
)(poc, vah, val, ffill_day(ovn_range), ffill_day(ovn_vol), va_width)

# --- Event Marker: Overnight Session Close ---
# Mark each overnight session close with the final money profile levels
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Overnight Session Close',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='POC', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='VAH', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='VAL', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='VA Width', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='Range', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(raw_poc, raw_vah, raw_val, ovn_high - ovn_low, ovn_high - ovn_low, ovn_closed)
